leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a form using Angular's Reactive Forms module
Integrate Zod schemas with Angular form controls for validation
Configure form validation rules using Zod's validation methods
Bind form inputs to reactive form controls with proper data types
Manipulate form state and validation messages based on Zod validation results
Initialize a form with default values that comply with Zod schema requirements
Render validation feedback in the UI by connecting Zod errors to form controls
lessonTitle: Form Validation with Zod + React Hook Form
